coordinate_unit: input coordinate unit; meter convention remains unverified
requirements: Use every finite input XYZ point for the headline point-to-mesh diagnostic; report max and outliers as well as percentiles.
A good global average cannot excuse a failed observed facade segment or roof patch.
Do not use normal filtering, global plane support rank or a rectangular footprint to delete a supported local feature.
Preserve supported concave corners, setbacks, steps and roof fixtures; complexity reduction is secondary to fit.
Footprint validation uses a separately derived unsimplified alpha boundary and a 0.15-unit support band for unsupported area.
Roof-patch checks include locally matched points, including high residual features; facade checks use normal-aligned observed segments.
Mesh-to-point distances on unobserved facades/ground must be reported separately from observed-surface fitting; missing scan returns are not proof of empty space.
Verticality and local planar continuation may fill occlusions only while consistent with observed boundaries; do not add unobserved windows or facade ornament.
Do not equate watertight topology with geometric accuracy, and do not label same-input diagnostics as official CD/ECD/NC.
These are provisional engineering gates, not official benchmark thresholds; never relax gates merely to make the current outputs pass.
